listingMobileLcpDiagnosis.finding: The first listing cover is the LCP image in all six PT/EN mobile samples. It is discoverable in the initial HTML but loading=lazy with no initial fetchpriority=high hint. Resource load delay and duration dominate; render delay is small.
listingMobileLcpDiagnosis.followup: Preserve this failed round; prioritize only the first listing cover through existing CaseImage support, validate with RED/GREEN, then measure a newly deployed candidate using the unchanged protocol.

limitations: Browser uses loopback relay; each request traverses real staging network and TLS upstream plus local forwarding overhead.
Browser-side Lighthouse throttling is applied to relay traffic, not to the shared VPS.
Staging has Basic Auth, private noindex policy and disabled Analytics; production is not measured.
Bind the run to independent SSH receipts for candidate digest and publication root before and after measurement.
Individual sample budget excursions remain in this receipt; acceptance uses the frozen median of three.
No production, field INP, NVDA, or final editorial-content approval is established by this laboratory run.
privateEvidencePolicy: Raw LHR files remain under .work. Export only this compact receipt, sanitized config/calibration, and hashes; no authentication data or private raw HTML.
